nom: Onekind Solardrops SPF 55 Daily Broad Spectrum Sunscreen

avis.texte: I've been searching for a mineral-based SPF to wear that feels light yet effective and doesn't leave any residue. Solardrops has been the answer to this issue. A little goes a long way and lasts well while providing hydration. It also smells great!
I haven't had enough time to practice with this one. I think it's a little heavy and makes my face very shiny but I think it would be great for underneath makeup.

The product starts a bit white and heavy, but it does dry down and match my skin. Maybe because it is 55 SPF, but I find it too heavy to wear on a daily basis or under make-up. I will save it for the beach/pool.

avis.titre: Not only is this a very m
avis.texte: Not only is this a very moisturizing sunscreen, it makes an amazing makeup primer
I don't leave the house without it. On my face and in my bag. A very light cover with SPF that pairs well with a daily moisturizer. Keep doing what you're doing over there, Motley Crew ????????

I've been using solardrops for about 3 years, after making the commitment to wearing sunscreen daily. I tried quite a few others, with my main issue being eye-stinging at some point in the day. With solardrops, I never have that issue. The product is a great texture, smells good, looks great alone or with makeup, and provides great protection.

avis.titre: I love that it is light-weight and has sparkle
avis.texte: I love that it is light-weight and has just a bit of sparkle, yet provides sufficient sun protection. I don't typically wear makeup, so this is a nice tint while protecting my sk8n. I've moved away from other brands of sunblock and intend to stick with Solar Drops.
This product just melts onto my face! The coverage feels like the best CLEAN spf protection available. How I wish this would have been available in my youth.
Love this moisturizer. A little too light for me so I mix it with another brand.

I am so happy with my purchase of Solardrops. Just love how dewy and moisturized my skin looks after application which is hard to find in a sunscreen. The coverage is so natural. So glad I purchased!!

I love to use the Solar Drops as sunscreen for my face when going to the beach. I love that it is not white, but pink so it blends into my skin better. It also lasts awhile and doesn't leave my skin feeling pasty. I haven't gotten burned with it on!

I had previously used the same Olay daily moisturizer for years in the mornings for SPF, and I recently started a skincare treatment that required mineral sunscreen on part of my face, so I added a second product that was chalky and white-cast. I was looking for a better solution when Onekind came out with Solar Drops. I use it to replace both previous morning moisturizers and overall I love it! PROS: good-for-your-skin ingredients, not white or chalky, great subtle tint that blends/melts into my skin easily. CONS: I want the container to be bigger (ha!), and it does have a slightly sharp smell, but this dissipates quickly. Also note: it appears a bit greasy/shiny when first applied, but just wait a minute or two and it soaks in. I'm a daily makeup wear-er and I've gone out with just Solardrops and mascara on multiple times!!
Heavy shine on skin, hard to rub in all the way, tint stays on skin like makeup. Used a few times and won't again.
I have more oily skin so I love that this doesn't leave my skin feeling greasey. And the smell is amazing!

I love Solardrops! I have tried other daily SPF serums and this is my favorite. It goes on smoothly, without any streaks, makes your face feel luxurious and gives your skin a beautiful glow. The price is very reasonable compared to others I have tried and I love that I don't have to use a lot of the product, so it lasts a me for a while.

Solardrops SPF 55 is an essential part of your daily routine. It absorbs quickly without leaving any residue, so you don't have to wait for it to be absorbed into your skin. Solardrops are amazing! If you haven't tried them yet, they are definitely worth the investment. Get yours today!
This is light and lovely. Smells terrific. Color blends naturally. Happy with the ingredients and if it's as effective at blocking the sun as it purports, I've found my new favorite daily sunscreen.

I'm obsessed with Solardrops! How do I count the ways. Yes it has wonderful sun protection but also moisturizes, primes the skin for cosmetics and amazingly enhances skin tone. I even use it at night because it beautifies my skin. It's a must must have on a desert island or anywhere else. My favorite Onekind product!

I just spent 4 months in Rehab facility recovering from Kidney Failure and congestive heart failure. I used Solardrops daily to brighten my skin. I wasn't outside at all , but was always complemented frequently about my skin. I love this product so much.
Love this product. Wish it gave a bit more coverage. But it goes on silky smooth and brightens my skin!

avis.titre: Solardrops SPF 55 broad spectrum sun screen
avis.texte: Really like everything about this facial sunscreen except it stains my shirts. So I wear stained shirts when using the awesome facial sunscreen
I love that it is an SPF 55. It covers a bit too. My only issue is that you have to put enough on and not rub or it starts to pill.

Looking for and SPF that doesn't give me a gray cast is already a hard time. But also finding an SPF that doesn't make me feel greasy or run into my eyes when I'm working out is doubt as hard and this solves BOTH problems! I keep this in my purse for reapplication throughout the day which is my go to use.
It feels great, leaves skin feeling hydrated, and is perfecting. My go to sunscreen now !
Goes on smooth and feels excellent on my skin. Will be reordering when I run out!!
I'm 75 and have used a lot of creams for sun protection , but this is the best. It is so flattering to my skin and offers great sun protection!
I've used quite a few tinted sunscreens, Solardrops are one of the best! They blend right in while giving amazing coverage and your skin can breathe while being protected.

This is probably the nicest most flattering sunscreen I used on my face. I need to use it every day because I am red hair and freckle face and honestly, it is a dream. It looks nice under make up. It looks nice without make up and it was on so nicely, I can't live without this
Love the Solardrops! I've never consistently worn SPF before. That has changed now. No greasy feel and doesn't run in my eyes when I exercise! One of my new favs!!

The Solardrops formula goes on smoothly, has a pleasant light scent, and doesn't cause my skin to breakout. I have always worn it without makeup and it has protected my skin against burns so far, and I burn very easily. I love the product. The only con is it is a small tube for the price and the amount needed to reapply if you're out in the sun all day.
I love how easily this sunscreen is to apply. Is makes my skin so glowy and a it is a great base to wear by itself, or under my make up! Will definitely be buy more.

I typically don't like tinted SPF, but decided to try this one because the write-up made it sound better. It goes on very smooth, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any film. It's sort of like rubbing cream on my face. And it doesn't rub off on my clothes. I do like this SPF and intend to buy it again.

I am very picky about sunblock. Living in Phoenix requires daily attention to protecting my skin from the sun. This serum spreads smoothly. I only use it on my cheeks and use non tinted of another brand elsewhere on my face. It spreads very evenly and seems to take red tints away but doesn't look pasty. I have had comments on how good my skin looks since I started using it. I definitely recommend it!

I took Solar Drops to the mountains recently where I used it for the first time. I was pleased with the initial glow it gave my skin and even more surprised at the protection it provided. I was hiking at 11000 feet and it held up even under the perspiration (no stinging in my eyes). I will continue to purchase this product - thumbs up for sure!

I have very dry skin and it's hard to find a facial sunscreen that doesn't feel dry or chalky on me. This one moisturizes without feeling greasy and because it's slightly tinted, it blends in perfectly with my skin tone. I wear it under makeup everyday.
I love how it goes on my face so smoothly. It does not change my coloring. I feel very protected without any breakouts.

I really like this serum. It is lightweight and blends quite easily. There is little to no scent. It provides lightweight coverage and a glowy finish. A great addition to my skincare routine and an easy way to add SPF. I wear both alone and with a tinted moisturizer. It applies easily, and I don't feel that I have to use a lot to cover my entire face. Definitely will be part of my everyday routine.

yesterday, I finally used the serum for the first time and I am so impressed. my one fear was that it would stain my shirt and it did not. I was in the sun most of the day and it was perfect and I did not have to worry about too much sun. thank you onekind! I am going to continue trying new products, even for my older skin!!

avis.titre: It's a little tacky to we
avis.texte: It's a little tacky to wear under makeup, but I like to wear it alone. You do have to use a lot of it to make it count, so the name "drops" is a little silly. Smells really good and feels good on, though!
Incredible! Goes on smoothly, looks like luminous BB cream, excellent protection, gentle on skin. Absolutely ?? love it!

I'm on my first tube and have already purchased a back up so I never run out. This feels like your serum and your primer with the benefit of SPF 55 in a divine faintly lavender scent! It has enough coverage to even out the skin without any white cast. Perfect glowy combo to go under my tinted moisturizer. No pulling, no creasing or settling into fine lines. Don't hesitate on this one!

I have been looking for a moisturizing, clean, water-resistant, mineral sunscreen with no white cast. Onekind checks all my boxes and I love it! Application is great, finish is beautiful, and it works well under makeup.
I'm obsessed with Solardrops SPF 55 as I am the entire lineup! It feels so good on your skin. Not heavy, absorbs quickly and doubles as my foundation! Love it -- thanks, Onekind
Im using these as a foundation each morning. Gives me a dewy glow while protecting me from more sun damage
I was skeptical that a product with this much sunscreen could melt into my skin and blend in. SolarDrops feels lovely going on and leaves no white residue. I'm excited to use it going into summer.

avis.titre: Most Moisture of any sunscreen ever
avis.texte: I have been using solar drops now for a year or two. I got them in an Etsy bag and was hooked. Top selling point for me was that they are vegan and cruelty free. Sunscreen lotions aren't very moisturizing, but this one is especially good for older skin because it is so moisturizing. It thicker than most serums, but absorbs into the skin. I am a make up artist, and I also use it as a primer because it fills in pours and fine lines better than a lot of primers.
Love this product.. highlights skin tone in all seasons.. I use instead of liquid foundation and top with just a touch of powder and never feel gunked up

I really love this product! It is 100% mineral which is a requirement for me and has a nice, high 50 SPF. The tint works really well for my skin tone, and the consistency is less thick and sticky than other 100% mineral products I've tried. I wish the product was less expensive, but otherwise I would highly recommend it!

avis.titre: Get the glow without the sun
avis.texte: I use the Solardrops serum often without makeup. It gives skin a lovely glow while protecting if from sun damage. It's tinted and along with evening out my skin tone it blends in smoothly and easily.

I purchased Solar Drops and the nighttime Dream Cream only because I received a special discount via a daily newsletter. I was not in the market for SPF because I've used one I've liked for a few years. When I first put it on, I did think it would not be for me. It is heavier than I would have liked and worried it'd only make my oily skin more oily. I was completely wrong! Solar Drops acted as a great base/primer with SPF. My skin did not feel greasy after 10 hours. My make up looked freshly applied throughout the day. I've notice my skin looks much more even toned. The drawbacks are the price, and it might too heavy for my skin during the humid months. However, I'm leaning to toward a future purchase.
I play golf, the solardrops SPF 50, gives me great protection through 9holes. It is a hydrating formula with a slightest tint, which works well for me.
This spf is amazing, bless well under make-up, no white cast, and feels wonderful on my skin, so glad I gave it a try!

avis.titre: Not what I was hoping for
avis.texte: I really disliked the texture of this. It will not encourage me to use it daily.
I love this SPF Serum to throw on by itself if I'm running out of the house, or under my makeup for an extra boost of glow. It makes my skin feel hydrated and glowy without being too greasy or oily.
The solar drops are amazing ! They're very silky and go on easily. They blend in nicely too. Highly reccommend!
This serum has my skin glowy and is my new favorite SPF! Feels light and absorbs into my skin quickly, without any cast. I also do like the smell!

I've used many products for sun protection but Solar Drops is my new favorite! Provides excellent sun protection even at the beach with sun reflecting under the umbrella. Goes on evenly is light and non-greasy. I keep one tube with me at all times! Highly recommend this product!
I recently started using this and I really like it. It goes on so smooth and blends well. It is perfectly light to go on under foundation or tinted moisturizer. Give it a try.

I can't say enough good things about onekind products. I started with the night cream a few months ago and slowly added in the face wash, day cream and now the Solardrops SPF and my skin is GLOWING. I'm edging on 40 and I had okay skin before but I mean it when I say these products have changed my face and how I look at myself in the mirror. A tad pricey but worth it - it feels expensive on my face and I love that.

I do like this product and the protection it provides. It feels light and gives a slight glow to my face, and matches my fair complexion well. I use it, along with some concealer where needed, and it's enough for every day activities. I've already reordered.

avis.titre: Doesn't look, feel, or smell like sunscreen
avis.texte: Finally! A sunscreen that I can wear everyday that is kind to my skin. I always hated wearing sunscreen on my face. This one is the best. It does not look, feel, or smell like sunscreen. It blends in quickly and does not sting when I sweat. I forget I'm wearing it and love the fact that is SPF 55.
Hands down, I've tried them ALL-best feel, best coverage, best protection!! Continues to be my fave-even tho I'm at the end of the tube. My skin looks great and still isn't tired of the product!!

Hands down this is my favorite skin care product ever! If I could only use one product on my face ever (including makeup), it would be Solardrops. It's sun protection, a moisturizer and a primer in one. Feels yummy on the skin an looks heavenly. Buy it. Now.

I have very sensitive skin, but this does not irritate my skin. I love that it has a subtle tint to help even skin tone. When I put it on it gives me a dewy, even look. It also has a very pleasant smell. I use it as my daily sunscreen and love the extra benefits.
I purchased 2 tubes of solar drops and I love this product. It goes on smoothly and it gives me great protection from the sun. Really like the sheer zinc oxcide.

I love this product the fact that there's no white cast and the fact that it doesn't clog your pores. This feels so good on my skin and it's a summer must have. If you're looking for a good sunscreen this is the one you need.

Solardrops SPF 55 is what I have been looking for. I live at high altitude and have pale skin, consequently prone to skin cancer. Solardrops goes on very smoothly and I feel well protected when out and about.

I came to Onekind to support my dear old friend of 20 years Matt. I am now hooked, especially on Solar Drops! Spreads nicely, smells lovely, not sticky I can't fault it. I use about à dîme size amount and have typically oily skin but it doesn't make my skin oilier towards the end of the day. I live in Australia where the sun is harsh so SPF is a must, even in winter. I look forward to seeing how it performs in humid Australian summer.

avis.titre: Best SPF Serum on the Market
avis.texte: I initially bought Solar Drop serum because I got it at a discount and boy I am glad I did! I love the fact it has an SPF of 55 especially since I live in the south and the sun is intense. The product is light weight and love the way it looks after application. You could definitely wear it alone or under foundation. Will purchase again!

It's an average product - not fantastic but not bad. It does the job in terms of sun protection. The feel of the product is heavier than others, and leaves less of a glow than I'd like. Perhaps I need to try using less product!

I tried this new sunscreen yesterday. I was concerned at first because it felt very heavy on my skin after application. I applied it onto my un moisturized skin. It took about four to five minutes before it settled in and felt absorbed. It blended into my skin tone well. After one use, I am happy with this product.
It definitely gives my skin a glowy appearance. And it doesn't feel that heavy.
This is a nice sunscreen that also works as a makeup base or alone. Glowy! Wish it came in different shades as it's very light so it needs a bronzing powder on top, if you want more color.
I love, LOVE how my skin feels with solar drops and my skin looks so dewy and gorgeous. I get a lot of compliments!

Absolultely LOVING the Solardrops SPF 55 broad spectrum serum, its lightweight, dewy and the ingredient list is amazing. This wears well under your moisturizer like a serum or on top of your regular routine like a traditional SPF - you can wear this undermakeup or alone for a dewy natural glow. Absolutely obsessed with this product! < 3

avis.titre: Daily Staple: Beautiful glow and full sun protection
avis.texte: I've almost done a clean sweep using One Kind's facial products. Solardrops did NOT disappoint. It checked all the boxes in my quest for the best face and neck sunblock: SPF 50 or higher, easy to apply, no white cast (I'm brown-skinned and I go deep brown in the summer), doesn't react to other skincare and make-up, dewy/glowy and not drying, benign smell, easy to reapply, doesn't make me break out. I've worn this at the beach (full day, reapplied once), long walks, long bike rides, long days commuting and going from one appointment to the other, during strenuous workouts, gardening, events, etc. It's been a month and it's holding up really well. I highly recommend this! P.S. To prevent breakouts, wash and clean your hands thoroughly before reapplying. Also wash hands after application because it does stay on your fingers. I love the texture because it's dewy but not sticky, but it's not a good sensation left in your hand.

I have *very* sensitive skin and am always nervous to try new products. I needed an SPF to use in the sun walking my dog. So far I've had zero reactions and it's worked well as a SPF. I would recommend!
I don't get the bad reviews; that was not my experience… I loved that this replaces sunscreen and foundation. Maybe use moisturizer first….

avis.titre: What Solardrops will " dew " for you
avis.texte: Take my word for it: if you want soft dewy skin that lasts all day, adding this product to your serums and moisturizers is a MUST! I feel so pampered! Usually after a few hours I can feel my skin losing its moisture. But since I've been using Solardrops it literally lasts ALL DAY and I feel like a superhero knowing I'm protecting my skin from sun damage. This product really ups your skincare regime!

Finally an SPF that doesn't feel and smell like I'm headed to the pool on vacation. This is the first spf I've used that actually soaks into the skin and leaves my skin looking hydrated and not greasy/oily! Love that it also doesn't smell like traditional spf. It does take a minute or two to soak in- so don't worry about the initial shine. So happy with this new product

I'll be honest. I know I'm supposed to wear sunscreen daily but I've always dreaded it. But Solardrops changes everything. It doesn't leave a color tint but somehow makes my skin look smoother and more even - more so than the tinted SPFs I've tried to like in the past. Also, I always opt for mineral SPF (cleaner and doesn't make me break out), but I hate how it usually leaves you looking chalky and pale. I was thrilled that Solardrops gives a healthy, dewy finish to my skin! Perfect for summer.

I've been waiting for a Onekind SPF forever and I'm so happy they finally made one and that it's mineral. I like that it also hydrates so I've been using it as a substitution for moisturizer and oil. I really like when products multitask so I can keep my routine simple. And I like the way my skin looks after using it. Just give it a few minutes to absorb because at first I thought it was a tad shiny but then it faded quickly into just a nice glow that lasts all day.

I love OneKind but this product was not my favorite. There was no white cast and the tint worked well with my skin tone but the sunscreen felt very heavy and sticky on my skin and made my skin look greasy/oily for the rest of the day. I also felt like my makeup did not go on well after using Solardrops and also looked greasy.

I'm one of the lucky ones who got a chance to try this product early, and wow! I've loved all of Onekind's products, but I think Solardrops has taken the crown. ?? It feels so luxurious, is incredibly light-weight, natural fragrance is subtly perfect, and it gives no blue/white-cast — unlike any other mineral-based SPFs I've tried. I forget that I even put an SPF on! TBH, I've always hated using SPF (I know… I'm so bad), but after just a week of using this I can't go without it. I'll definitely be getting my hands on it as soon as it's officially released, and will make sure my shelf is never without it. ??

avis.titre: This is an essential skin care product!
avis.texte: I jumped at the chance to test out Solardrops. I am a Floridian and an SPF face product is as much a daily essential as sunglasses! Solardrops is the first SPF face product that has not irritated my eyes or made my skin feel goopy, and I have tried many . It has a smooth and dewy feeling when applying and seems to stay around for several hours, which is a good thing as who wants to be concerned about sunscreen wearing off in the middle of a bike ride? I was happy to use this for the last few weeks and feel that I have found a "skincare wardrobe" staple at last. Smells refreshing also. Thank you onekind-keep up the great work!

I have come to love OneKind products. When I was asked to test the SolarDrops SPF 55 serum I jumped at the opportunity. I'll be honest, the first review I wrote I complained about how the light color of the serum made my natural skin color look very waxy. And, I still hope that OneKind will eventually add more skin tones to this product. However, I have now used the product for 2 weeks and I have been very pleased with the results. It is an excellent sun protector, it glides on very smoothly and leaves my face soft. I can easily add makeup if I want to or leave it plain if I want to. The product will leave your face appearing a bit dewy and some people like that look. But for sun protection, it is an excellent product. For a moisturizer it is an excellent product. For leveling out the skin tone, it an excellent product.

I'm very impressed with the Solardrops. It is a mineral based sunscreen (which is important to me) and applies very easily without the need to rub it in much. It leaves my skin feeling great as a last step in the morning routine.

This serum has a very soft and light feel that still offers great coverage and leaves my skin feeling moist. I still paired with a moisturizer, but didn't feel the absolute need to add it on top of the serum, even in colder drier weather.
Everything about this sunscreen is superb! I love the way it goes on and its nice scent. My skin looks dewy but not greasy. I'm wearing it daily! It's my new go to sunscreen!

This is the perfect sunscreen. It goes on smoothly and leaves a dewy glow. It's a perfect primer and doesn't cause white specks as many sunscreens do with makeup. I have tried many sunscreens, but none have been this good. I even love the color. Highly recommend!

First I absolutely love the fact that this dows not leave a blue cast or have any type of sunscreen scent. A lot of products I've used in the past I had to stop using because of the scent so if that's something anyone is concerned with, this will not disappoint you!

avis.titre: Great face cream for the sun
avis.texte: I spend a lot of time outdoors for work, so it's important for me to have a good face cream with sun protection. Not only did this help protect my face (even outside for 8 hours in the sun) but it smells heavenly. It's not heavy feeling on the face, doesn't leave that thick "I've got sunscreen on" feel to it. Totally love it.

avis.titre: Perfect Daily SPF for Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: I have really sensitive skin and Onekind has been such a great find, and this new SPF Serum is no different! Amazing texture that goes on so easily with no cast (you don't need much) and lovely subtle scent. Looks great on it's own or under makeup and leaves skin feeling hydrated and healthy. I don't always love products described as "dewy" or "glowing", but this was really great, not too shiny at all. Definitely adding this to my regular routine!

I love that this sunscreen is 100% mineral based without a white/blue cast. I've been wanting to switch to mineral based sunscreen for my face for a while now! The pinkish tint rubs in well and is flattering on my fair skin tone. The scent is lovely and calming, without being overpowering. While the texture for me does feel a bit heavy/greasy, the pros definitely outweigh the con!

I was so excited to try Solardrops, especially while vacationing in Orlando! It was amazing! Blended in my skin easily, like a serum, and made my skin feel moisturized and supple. It's tinted, so even with no makeup over it, my skin tone looked even and bright. When applying, it looked a bit too shiny to me, but that settled out once it became absorbed, and in the end, gave my face a nice glow. Best of all, the protection was amazing! Lasted all day at a theme park and easily reapplied as needed when poolside or at the beach! Great product that will definitely become part of my facial routine!

LOVE SOLARDROPS! the texture is silky and has a light lovely fragrance! blends beautifully into my skin and has a slight pink hue that glows! lasts all day and is now part of my go too morning routine with all my other ONEKIND products! My skin is calm and no more breakouts! thank u Madison and team! xoxo
Incredible serum for my sensitive fair skin! Moisturizing and so silky not to mention it smells amazing! Onekind is my new skin care obsession!

Absolutely obsessed with this product, not only is my skin the softest it's ever been, but it gives a gorgeous dewy glow. This is my new go to product, I don't feel like I need any makeup. It even out my complexion and my skin felt hydrated all day.
I'm very fair skinned & most important to me is that this sunscreen works.. i've had no sunburn on bike rides & walks. ?? I'm also loving the silky feel & the clear coverage.

I love this sunscreen! The glow is unmatched and I weirdly really love the subtle smell?? The texture is so nice and it looks incredible under makeup. It does take a bit of working into the skin to avoid any cast, but the end result is worth it. Will be repurchasing for summer for sure!
I've been waiting for OneKind to have an SPF product. This is the one. Light and non greasy. Provides a little glow and looks great without makeup for those quick mornings.

This is great for the summer and as a finishing step in my morning care routine. The sun drops are more like a serum so it goes on smooth and feels light on my face. The spf 55 is great for protecting my face all day long.

I have extremely sensitive skin and daily sunblock has always been an issue for me because I react so badly to it. I've been wearing this daily for a week now and have had zero reactions. It doesn't feel greasy, absorbs into my skin nicely, and the faint fragrance is nice. I've not worn makeup over it yet (I don't wear makeup during allergy season) but I'm planning a trial run with a full face of makeup tomorrow. But, it gives my face a great glow solo so I don't feel like I'm not wearing makeup

This Serum is a dream-like texture that melts into your skin. I have 60 year-old skin and it melted in without hanging out in any of my fine lines, so I have a soft, moist look and a perfect palette for my make up. I even tried it later in the day, for afternoon sun exposure, after I had make up on and it went on smoothly and added a fresh look of hydration-not oily or heavy, just the right amount of dewy smoothness. I love that this is SPF 55, so I'm getting the protection I want without heavy white/blue lotion. Thank you for creating such a lovely product!! I will be purchasing again!
Finally an SPF that doesn't make my beard white! The smell is soo good and it stays on in the pool. Love this, just wish they had a larger size to buy.

I love this sunscreen. It goes on smooth and silky and blends in perfectly with my skin. I love the subtle pretty scent. It give my skin a nice dewy glow. Love using it daily with all my other One Kind products!
